title: A-727 automatic: drain (pan and converter), new filter, refill (1976-77 Dodge W/D trucks)
summary: Army procedure for draining the A-727 including the torque converter, fitting a new filter, and refilling and checking the level.
warnings: From the Army manual for the M880 (military 1976-77 Dodge W200/D200). Confirm a civilian truck has the same part before using a number.

specs.name: Initial refill
specs.value: 6 qt Dexron-type ATF, then top up to level

steps.text: Put a wide drain pan under the transmission. Loosen the pan bolts, tap one corner of the pan to break it loose and let it drain, then remove the pan.
Remove the access plate in front of the torque converter and take out the converter drain plug. Let it drain, reinstall and tighten the plug, and refit the access plate.
Adjust the low-reverse band now if it needs it (the pan is already off).
Install a new filter on the bottom of the valve body; retaining screws 35 in-lb.
Clean the pan and reinstall it with a new gasket; pan bolts 150 in-lb.
Pour 6 quarts of Dexron-type ATF through the filler tube.
Start the engine and idle at least 2 minutes. With the parking brake on, move the selector briefly through each position and finish in neutral.
Add fluid to the ADD ONE PINT mark. Recheck at operating temperature: the level should sit between FULL and ADD ONE PINT.
Seat the dipstick cap fully on the filler tube so dirt can't get in.

body: The 19-pint figure is the total capacity from Table 1-1 (Tabulated Data). The drain-and-refill quantity in para. 4-9 is the 6 quarts above plus the top-up to the dipstick.

sources.title: TM 9-2320-266-34: Direct and General Support Maintenance Manual, Truck, Cargo, 1-1/4 Ton, 4x4 (M880 series)
sources.publisher: Headquarters, Department of the Army, January 1976 (reprint with Changes 1-7)
sources.citation: Para. 4-9, Draining and Refilling Transmission Fluid; Table 1-1, Tabulated Data
